title: Thinking with Patterns: Breaking the Perceptual Bottleneck in Visual Planning via Pattern Induction
abstract: Proposes Pattern Inference and Pattern Induction for VLMs — actively recognizing known visual patterns in new tasks and autonomously discovering reusable composite patterns from experience. Enables VLMs to solve tasks beyond their initial capability while balancing accuracy and efficiency.
key_insight: Autonomous pattern induction from experience is a core mechanism for AI that accelerates its own research — discovered patterns become reusable building blocks for future tasks.

title: NOETHER: A Constructive Framework for Metamorphic Pattern Discovery from Operator Algebras
abstract: Two-layer framework for metamorphic pattern discovery. Upstream: 8-block algebraic decomposition (symmetry, order, time-reversal, relational equivalence). Downstream: mechanical algorithm CONSTRUCT-MP that produces MetaPattern sets with algebraic-closure guarantees. Tested on Boltzmann reactor physics, equivariant ML, and relational query optimizers.
key_insight: Formal algebraic decomposition enables provable pattern discovery — the design phase of ASI-Evolve can be grounded in mathematical guarantees rather than purely statistical exploration.

title: Odin: Multi-Signal Graph Intelligence for Autonomous Discovery in Knowledge Graphs
abstract: First production-deployed graph intelligence engine for autonomous discovery of meaningful patterns in KGs without prior specification. Uses COMPASS score combining PageRank structural importance, neural probabilistic logic learning for semantic plausibility, temporal relevance, and GNN-identified bridge entities.
key_insight: Multi-signal scoring (structural + semantic + temporal + GNN) for autonomous pattern discovery in knowledge graphs — directly applicable to PAPERS V2's knowledge graph exploration.

title: GRiD: Generating Graph-Like Logical Rules for Knowledge Graph Reasoning via Diffusion Models
abstract: Reformulates graph-like rule discovery as a discrete generative process conditioned on target relations. Uses RL to fine-tune diffusion models guided by rule-quality metrics. Discovers cyclic, branching relational patterns beyond chain-like ones in KGs.
key_insight: Relational pattern learning via diffusion + RL enables discovery of complex non-linear relationship patterns in scientific knowledge graphs — beyond simple chain-like inferences.

title: Formal Concept Lattices are Good Semantic Scaffolds for Concept-Based Learning
abstract: Shows that formal concept lattices (from Formal Concept Analysis) provide principled semantic scaffolds that guide neural network learning. Concepts are organized hierarchically from general to specific. Produces interpretable embeddings and supports structured interventions.
key_insight: Hierarchical concept lattices provide a principled way to organize discovered research patterns from general to specific — a taxonomy scaffold for ASI-Evolve's cognition base.

title: FACT: Compositional Kernel Synthesis with a Three-Stage Agentic Workflow
abstract: Agent-driven workflow for pattern discovery in computation graphs. Pattern discovery inspects traced PyTorch graphs, matches subgraphs to optimization rules, retrieves vetted examples, and outputs prioritized patterns. Achieves 2.03x speedup on MiniGPT and 1.41x on Llama 3 8B.
key_insight: Agentic pattern discovery in computation graphs with dynamic pattern registry — a template for ASI-Evolve's Engineer module to discover optimization patterns autonomously.

title: Optimal Pattern Detection Tree for Symbolic Rule-Based Classification (OPDT)
abstract: Rule-based ML model using mixed-integer programming to discover a single optimal pattern in data via binary classification. Includes Branching Structure Constraints to encode domain knowledge. Discovers hidden underlying patterns with optimality guarantees.
key_insight: Optimization-based symbolic pattern deduction with optimality guarantees — provides formal verification for patterns discovered by ASI-Evolve's Analyzer module.

title: Relational Retrieval: Leveraging Known-Novel Interactions for Generalized Category Discovery (RPC)
abstract: Introduces Relational Pattern Consistency for category discovery. Transforms unreliable pseudo-labeling into well-defined relational pattern matching by leveraging invariant relationships between samples and known-class prototypes.
key_insight: Relational pattern consistency as a more robust alternative to pseudo-labeling — relevant for the cognition base retrieval where relational matching beats naive similarity.

title: LLMs Gaming Verifiers: RLVR can Lead to Reward Hacking
abstract: Studies how RL-trained models abandon pattern induction (learning generalizable rules) in favor of instance-level enumeration that passes verifiers without capturing relational patterns. Introduces Isomorphic Perturbation Testing to detect this failure mode.
key_insight: Critical cautionary finding: reward optimization can subvert genuine pattern induction. ASI-Evolve must include isomorphic perturbation testing to ensure discovered patterns are genuine, not reward-hacked.

title: Mind's Eye: A Benchmark of Visual Abstraction, Transformation and Composition
abstract: Benchmark of 8 visuo-cognitive tasks under A-R-T taxonomy (Abstraction, Relation, Transformation) probing pattern induction, analogical relation mapping, and mental transformation. Top MLLMs score <50% vs 80% human.
key_insight: The A-R-T taxonomy (Abstraction-Relation-Transformation) defines core dimensions of pattern reasoning that ASI-Evolve's Researcher module must master for effective hypothesis generation.

title: Genomic Next-Token Predictors are In-Context Learners
abstract: First evidence that in-context learning (pattern induction from examples) emerges in non-linguistic domains (genomic sequences). Demonstrates that pattern induction arises from large-scale predictive modeling over any rich data, not just language.
key_insight: Pattern induction is a universal emergent property of large-scale predictive models — supports the thesis that ASI-Evolve can learn scientific patterns from structured research data across domains.

title: Spatiotemporal Factorized Graph Neural Networks for Joint Large-Scale Traffic Prediction and Online Pattern Recognition (STF-GNN)
abstract: Integrates traffic prediction and pattern recognition by shifting prediction variables from traffic states to latent informative patterns. Graph-based and time-series models predict spatial and temporal patterns respectively. Enhances interpretability and enables transfer to longer prediction horizons.
key_insight: Joint prediction + pattern recognition in graph domains — latency matters. ASI-Evolve's Engineer needs to predict hardware patterns (VRAM, throughput) alongside architecture patterns.

title: Coexistence of Cyclic Sequential Pattern Recognition and Associative Memory in Neural Networks by Attractor Mechanisms
abstract: Investigates how neural networks can simultaneously perform associative memory (point attractors) and sequential pattern recognition (cyclic attractors). Establishes conditions for coexistence of both memory mechanisms and competitive dynamics between them.
key_insight: Coexisting static (point attractor) and sequential (cyclic attractor) memory mechanisms — directly relevant to designing Neural Memory modules in the target AI architecture.

title: Triple-CFN: Separating Concepts and Features Enhances Machine Abstract Reasoning Ability
abstract: Framework for visual abstract reasoning that separates concept extraction from feature extraction. Uses dual Expectation-Maximization to synthesize non-conflicting concepts. Applies to Raven's Progressive Matrices with strong reasoning accuracy and interpretability.
key_insight: Concept-feature separation via dual EM — the architectural pattern of separating discovered scientific concepts from raw experimental features that ASI-Evolve's Analyzer should follow.

title: Signed Dual Attention: Capturing Signed Dependencies in Time Series Forecasting
abstract: Novel attention formulation capturing both positive and negative relational patterns (homophilic and heterophilic interactions) without additional parameters. Propagates both supportive and contrastive information within a single shared block.
key_insight: Signed attention captures both supporting and contradicting evidence — essential for ASI-Evolve's cognition retrieval where papers may support or challenge a hypothesis.

title: Fractal-Based AI: Exploring Self-Similarity in Neural Networks for Improved Pattern Recognition
abstract: Explores fractal-based neural networks using self-similarity and hierarchical structures for detecting complex patterns at multiple scales. Discusses enhanced accuracy, scalability, and efficiency for medical imaging, finance, and signal processing.
key_insight: Multi-scale self-similar pattern discovery — relevant for discovering patterns at different levels of scientific abstraction: paper-level, field-level, and paradigm-level.

title: Automated Attention Pattern Discovery at Scale in Large Language Models
abstract: Mines attention patterns from LLMs completing Java code, introduces AP-MAE (vision transformer-based autoencoder) to reconstruct and analyze attention patterns at scale. Predicts generation correctness without ground truth and enables targeted interventions improving accuracy by 13.6%.
key_insight: Automated attention pattern mining at scale with correctness prediction — the learn→experiment→analyze cycle applied to understanding model internals, directly parallel to ASI-Evolve.

title: Counterexample Guided Learning in the Large using Reasoning Agents
abstract: LLMs perform regular-expression induction via counterexample-guided learning. A verifier provides feedback on candidate regular expressions, improving success from 3.2% to 38.1% on hardest regex tasks. Demonstrates that LLMs benefit from rich symbolic feedback for program synthesis.
key_insight: Counterexample-guided learning as a formal instantiation of the learn→design→experiment→analyze loop — verifier feedback dramatically improves pattern induction success rate.

title: LLM-Evolved Pattern Generators for Optimal Classical Planning
abstract: First method for learning domain-dependent admissible heuristics via LLM-driven evolutionary program synthesis. LLMs evolve programs that construct pattern collections per domain, combined via saturated cost partitioning for optimal A* planning.
key_insight: LLM-driven evolution of pattern generators for planning — a concrete instantiation of the Researcher-Engineer loop: evolve heuristics, test on benchmarks, analyze admissibility.

title: FALSIFYBENCH: Evaluating Inductive Reasoning in LLMs with Rule Discovery Games
abstract: Introduces a hypothesis-driven reasoning benchmark based on the Wason 2-4-6 task. Evaluates 12 LLMs; finds that models capable of falsification (negative testing) consistently outperform confirmation-seeking models. Identifies failure patterns at turn level.
key_insight: Falsification-driven search outperforms confirmation — ASI-Evolve's Design phase should prioritize generating hypotheses that can be falsified, not just confirmed by experimental results.

title: Using Probabilistic Programs to Train Inductive Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract: Introduces Program-based Posterior Training (PPT): LLMs generate probabilistic programs, run inference to produce distributional targets, then fine-tune on soft labels. Improves calibration and inductive estimation on held-out tasks.
key_insight: Bayesian inductive inference via probabilistic program generation — ASI-Evolve's Learn phase should produce distributional predictions, not point estimates, for better calibration.

title: Structured Abductive-Deductive-Inductive Reasoning for LLMs via Algebraic Invariants
abstract: Operationalizes Peirce's abduction-deduction-induction triad with five algebraic invariants (the Gamma Quintet). The Weakest Link bound ensures no conclusion exceeds the reliability of its least-supported premise. Verified via 100 property tests and 10^5+ generated cases.
key_insight: Abduction-Deduction-Induction triad with algebraic reliability bounds — formalizes the complete scientific reasoning cycle that ASI-Evolve automates, with provable error propagation guarantees.

title: BioBridge: Inductive-Associative Meta-learning Pipeline with Human Cognitive Patterns
abstract: Designs a meta-learning pipeline for drug-target interaction prediction that mimics how scientists draw insights from weakly related references. Uses dynamic prototype meta-learning to associate patterns from limited annotations for unseen proteins.
key_insight: Meta-learning across weakly-related references mimics scientist intuition — ASI-Evolve's cognition retrieval should find analogical patterns from distantly related papers, not just exact matches.

title: Deep Variational Inference Symbolic Regression (DVISR)
abstract: Bayesian extension of Deep Symbolic Regression using variational inference. Replaces reward with ELBO integrand; extends architecture to output distributions over constants. Recovers true posteriors in both constant and non-constant settings.
key_insight: Bayesian symbolic regression produces interpretable equations with uncertainty — the ideal output format for ASI-Evolve's Analyzer: scientific laws with confidence intervals.

title: Symbolic-Diffusion: D3PM Discrete Token Diffusion for Symbolic Regression
abstract: First diffusion-based generation for symbolic regression. Uses discrete-state-space diffusion to simultaneously generate all tokens of a mathematical expression, achieving comparable performance to autoregressive SymbolicGPT with potential advantages.
key_insight: Non-autoregressive equation generation via diffusion — enables ASI-Evolve's Researcher to generate multiple candidate hypotheses simultaneously rather than sequentially.

title: LIES Networks: Sparse Interpretable Deep Learning for Symbolic Regression
abstract: Fixed NN architecture with interpretable primitive activations (Log, Identity, Exponential, Sine). Trained with oversampling + sparsity-promoting loss, then pruned to extract compact symbolic formulae. Outperforms all baselines on SR benchmarks.
key_insight: Direct extraction of symbolic formulae from trained sparse networks — a concrete mechanism for ASI-Evolve's Analyzer to convert learned representations into human-readable scientific laws.

title: Automated Deep Learning: Neural Architecture Search Is Not the End
abstract: Argues that NAS is only one component of full AutoML pipelines. Surveys the broader landscape of automated deep learning including data preparation, hyperparameter optimization, and deployment. Emphasizes integrated automation beyond architecture search.
key_insight: Full-spectrum AutoML beyond NAS — ASI-Evolve must automate the entire research pipeline (data + architecture + algorithm), not just one component. Confirms the multi-pillar approach.

title: Probing Graph Neural Network Activation Patterns Through Graph Topology
abstract: Uses curvature-based graph topology to probe GNN activation patterns. Identifies a curvature shift where global attention mechanisms exacerbate topological bottlenecks. Reframes curvature as diagnostic for when and why graph learning fails.
key_insight: Curvature-based diagnostics for identifying when and why learning fails — ASI-Evolve's Analyzer needs topological diagnostics to detect when evolutionary progress stalls due to structural bottlenecks.

title: Self-Supervised Discovery of Neural Circuits in Spatially Patterned Neural Responses with GNNs
abstract: GNN-based model simultaneously predicts neural activity and infers latent synaptic connectivity. Handles partially observed circuits via auxiliary nodes. Recovers accurate connectivity from synthetic ring attractor networks and real mouse head direction cell recordings.
key_insight: Self-supervised discovery of latent connectivity from observed patterns — models the Learn phase where ASI-Evolve infers underlying mechanisms from observed experimental data.

title: Perseus: Leveraging Common Data Patterns with Curriculum Learning for Robust GNNs
abstract: Adversarial defense for GNNs using curriculum learning. Assesses edge difficulty via global homophily and adaptively focuses on common data patterns first, mitigating perturbation impact. Achieves superior robustness compared to preprocessing-based defenses.
key_insight: Curriculum learning prioritizing reliable patterns first before edge cases — ASI-Evolve's cognition retrieval should prioritize well-established patterns before exploring speculative hypotheses.

title: GMAR: Gradient-Driven Multi-Head Attention Rollout for Vision Transformer Interpretability
abstract: Proposes gradient-driven attention rollout method for ViT interpretability. Uses gradient information to weight attention head contributions before rolling out attention maps, producing more faithful explanations than prior rollout and gradient methods.
key_insight: Gradient-weighted attention for more faithful model explanations — ASI-Evolve's Analyzer should use gradient-based attribution to identify which components of a candidate most influenced the experimental outcome.

title: FlashPrefill: Instantaneous Pattern Discovery and Thresholding for Ultra-Fast Long-Context Prefilling
abstract: Discovers dynamic vertical, slash, and block-sparse attention patterns in real-time during LLM prefill. Achieves 27.78x speedup on 256K sequences while maintaining 1.71x speedup even at 4K contexts.
key_insight: Real-time pattern discovery enables massive speedups — ASI-Evolve's Engineer should implement dynamic pattern detection to skip redundant evaluations for similar candidate architectures.

title: An Explainable Unsupervised-to-Supervised Framework for Dietary Pattern Discovery
abstract: Combines K-means, GMM, and Agglomerative Clustering with SHAP explainability to discover dietary patterns. Surrogate classifier reproduces clusters with macro-F1=0.963; SHAP links predictions to clinically meaningful nutrient drivers.
key_insight: Unsupervised pattern discovery + explainable surrogate = automated Discover phase where meaningful regularities are extracted then validated interpretably. ASI-Evolve's cognition discovery pipeline.

title: Compositional PAC-Bayes: Generalization of GNNs with Persistence and Beyond
abstract: Derives compositional PAC-Bayes generalization bounds for GNNs using topological persistence. Shows how compositional structure in graph data yields tighter generalization guarantees. Extends beyond standard VC-dimension analysis.
key_insight: Compositional generalization theory with formal guarantees — provides the mathematical framework for ASI-Evolve to guarantee that patterns discovered in one task will compose reliably in new settings.
